progression_rule: First clear of stage N for class unlocks stage N+1 for that class and gives exactly one class level; define initial class level 1 and cap at 100.

reward_rules.first_clear_each_class: standard stage loot and account XP or class-specific rewards without duplicated premium milestones
reward_rules.premium_milestone: once per account across all classes

future_cap: 200+ after new stages are shipped; bonus caps must stay bounded
